fullText.simplified:
第二十一章、线索初定

    结合各种资料和研究，王教授有了一些大胆的猜测：金凫雁原本是在水禽坑的，它本身就是钥匙；藏于水禽中，意思是说把金凫雁隐身在这些水禽里。
    王教授看了一眼那首诗，继续说：“虽然刚才这些是从野史上得来的，并不能作为考据。但你看这首诗，也在说金凫雁能够开启秦始皇陵内某处机关，并会带来翻天覆地的变化。种种因素加起来，我们是否可以猜测，找到了金凫雁所在的坑，就找到了秦始皇陵的入口？”
    “这……这太危险了！太危险了！如果……如果窃贼也知道这些，后果不堪设想！我要先去趟警察局，把我们的最新发现告诉他们。我们随时电话联系，我先走一步！”李主任一边穿外套一边快步走出门，匆匆地向大家道了别。
    李主任走后，石文谦和简西继续跟王教授请教了很多问题。他们一起探讨了资料中的很多细节。大家越聊越投机，话题也越来越广，不仅聊到了秦始皇陵的谜题，石文谦还把和简西在敦煌的探险经历讲给王教授听。等他们从王教授家出来时，天色已经很黑了。
    “文谦，好饿啊，你听到我肚子叫了吗？”简西摸着肚子说道。
    “确实有点儿饿了。巷子口有小吃摊，我们去吃点东西吧。”石文谦想起了今天看到的西安特色小吃。
    等肉夹馍和胡辣汤摆上桌，石文谦和简西立刻大口大口地吃了起来。除此之外，简西还点了一份羊肉泡馍。这是把馍分成小块，然后放在羊肉汤里，让馍充分吸收汤汁，再配上汤里的羊肉片，一口下肚简直是太满足了。
    “文谦，这也太好吃了吧！这趟西安真的没白来！”简西又喝了一大口羊肉汤。
    石文谦都没顾上回答简西，他又吃了好几口肉夹馍，才点点头说道：“是啊！这趟太值了！没想到我能见到王明教授，我太崇拜他了！真的是学到太多东西了。还有金凫雁和秦始皇陵，如果那些推断都是正确的，又是件震惊历史学界和考古学界的大事！”
    “文谦，你想不想……”简西放下了手里的吃的，看向石文谦。
    “你不会是要去秦始皇陵吧？”石文谦了解简西，每次一说到跟文物探险有关的事，她的行动力绝对是最强的，总有一探究竟的架势。
    果然，简西点了点头。
fullText.traditional:
第二十一章、線索初定

    結合各種資料和研究，王教授有了一些大膽的猜測：金鳧雁原本是在水禽坑的，牠本身就是鑰匙；藏於水禽中，意思是說把金鳧雁隱身在這些水禽裡。
    王教授看了一眼那首詩，繼續說：“雖然剛才這些是從野史上得來的，並不能作為考據。但你看這首詩，也在說金鳧雁能夠開啟秦始皇陵內某處機關，並會帶來翻天覆地的變化。種種因素加起來，我們是否可以猜測，找到了金鳧雁所在的坑，就找到了秦始皇陵的入口？”
    “這……這太危險了！太危險了！如果……如果竊賊也知道這些，後果不堪設想！我要先去趟警察局，把我們的最新發現告訴他們。我們隨時電話聯繫，我先走一步！”李主任一邊穿外套一邊快步走出門，匆匆地向大家道了別。
    李主任走後，石文謙和簡西繼續跟王教授請教了很多問題。他們一起探討了資料中的很多細節。大家越聊越投機，話題也越來越廣，不僅聊到了秦始皇陵的謎題，石文謙還把和簡西在敦煌的探險經歷講給王教授聽。等他們從王教授家出來時，天色已經很黑了。
    “文謙，好餓啊，你聽到我肚子叫了嗎？”簡西摸著肚子說道。
    “確實有點兒餓了。巷子口有小吃攤，我們去吃點東西吧。”石文謙想起了今天看到的西安特色小吃。
    等肉夾饃和胡辣湯擺上桌，石文謙和簡西立刻大口大口地吃了起來。除此之外，簡西還點了一份羊肉泡饃。這是把饃分成小塊，然後放在羊肉湯裡，讓饃充分吸收湯汁，再配上湯裡的羊肉片，一口下肚簡直是太滿足了。
    “文謙，這也太好吃了吧！這趟西安真的沒白來！”簡西又喝了一大口羊肉湯。
    石文謙都沒顧上回答簡西，他又吃了好幾口肉夾饃，才點點頭說道：“是啊！這趟太值了！沒想到我能見到王明教授，我太崇拜他了！真的是學到太多東西了。還有金鳧雁和秦始皇陵，如果那些推斷都是正確的，又是件震驚歷史學界和考古學界的大事！”
    “文謙，你想不想……”簡西放下了手裡的吃的，看向石文謙。
    “你不會是要去秦始皇陵吧？”石文謙了解簡西，每次一說到跟文物探險有關的事，她的行動力絕對是最強的，總有一探究竟的架勢。
    果然，簡西點了點頭。

sentences.pinyin: wén qiān nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng jiǎn xī fàng xià le shǒu lǐ de chī de kàn xiàng shí wén qiān
sentences.english: “Wenqian, do you want to …” Jian Xi put down the food in her hand and looked at Shi Wenqian.

sentences.simplified: “你不会是要去秦始皇陵吧？”
sentences.traditional: “你不會是要去秦始皇陵吧？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bú huì shì yào qù qín shǐ huáng líng ba
sentences.english: “You’re not planning to go to the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang, are you?”

sentences.simplified: 石文谦了解简西，
sentences.traditional: 石文謙了解簡西，
sentences.pinyin: shí wén qiān liǎo jiě jiǎn xī
sentences.english: Shi Wenqian understood Jian Xi well.

sentences.traditional: 每次一說到跟文物探險有關的事，她的行動力絕對是最強的，

sentences.english: Whenever it came to anything related to artifact exploration, her drive was always the strongest, ..

sentences.simplified: 总有一探究竟的架势。
sentences.traditional: 總有一探究竟的架勢。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng yǒu yí tàn jiū jìng de jià shi
sentences.english: .. and she was always determined to get to the bottom of things.

sentences.simplified: 果然，简西点了点头。
sentences.traditional: 果然，簡西點了點頭。

sentence_translations: Chapter 21: Initial Clues
Based on various materials and research, Professor Wang came up with some bold speculations:
The golden swan goose was originally in the waterfowl pit, and the golden swan goose itself was the key.
It was hidden among the waterfowl, meaning that the golden swan goose was concealed within these waterfowl.
Professor Wang glanced at the poem and continued, ..
.. “What I just mentioned comes from unofficial historical records and cannot be used as evidence.
But look at this poem.
It also mentions that the golden swan goose can activate a certain mechanism within the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang, ..
.. which will bring about earth-shattering changes.
Considering all these factors, can we speculate that if we find the pit where the golden swan goose is located, ..
.. we will also find the entrance to the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang?”
“This … this is too dangerous! Too dangerous! If … if the thief also knows this, the consequences would be unimaginable!
I need to go to the police station first to inform them of our latest findings.
We can keep in touch by phone. I’ll head out now!”
Director Li put on his coat as he quickly walked out the door, hurriedly saying goodbye to everyone.
After Director Li left, Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi continued to ask Professor Wang many questions.
Together, they discussed many details from the materials.
The more they talked, the more they connected, and the conversation broadened.
They not only discussed the puzzles of the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang, ..
.. Shi Wenqian also told Professor Wang about his adventures with Jian Xi in Dunhuang.
By the time they left Professor Wang’s house, the sky had already grown very dark.
“Wenqian, I’m so hungry! Did you hear my stomach growling?” Jian Xi said, patting her belly.
“I’m definitely a bit hungry. There are food stalls at the entrance of the alley. Let’s go grab something to eat.”
Shi Wenqian remembered the Xi’an specialty snacks that he had seen that day.
When the roujiamo and hulatang were served, Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi immediately started eating in big mouthfuls.
Other than these, Jian Xi also ordered a serving of lamb paomo.
This involves tearing the bread into small pieces and placing it in lamb soup, allowing the bread to soak up the broth completely.
With slices of lamb in the soup, each bite is just incredibly satisfying.
“Wenqian, this is absolutely delicious! This trip to Xi’an was definitely worth it!” Jian Xi took another big mouthful of the lamb soup.
Shi Wenqian didn’t even bother to answer Jian Xi. He took several more bites of his roujiamo before nodding and saying, ..
.. “Yes! This trip has been so worthwhile! I never expected to meet Professor Wang Ming. I admire him so much! I’ve really learned a lot.
And then there’s also the golden swan goose and the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang.
If those inferences are correct, it would be a major event that would astonish the fields of history and archaeology!”
“Wenqian, do you want to …” Jian Xi put down the food in her hand and looked at Shi Wenqian.
“You’re not planning to go to the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang, are you?”
Shi Wenqian understood Jian Xi well.
Whenever it came to anything related to artifact exploration, her drive was always the strongest, ..
.. and she was always determined to get to the bottom of things.
Sure enough, Jian Xi nodded.
